source.task_prompt: Write a python function to check whether all the bits are unset in the given range or not.

generation.text:
```python
def all_Bits_Set_In_The_Given_Range(number, start_bit, end_bit):
    """
    Check if all bits in the given range [start_bit, end_bit] are set in the number.
    
    :param number: Integer to check bits in.
    :param start_bit: Start of the bit range (inclusive).
    :param end_bit: End of the bit range (inclusive).
    :return: True if all bits in the range are set, False otherwise.
    """
    mask = ((1 << (end_bit - start_bit + 1)) - 1) << start_bit
    return (number & mask) == mask
```
